en-US.description: A libre server and cloud storage browser for Mac and Windows with support for FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, Amazon S3, OpenStack Swift, Backblaze B2, Microsoft Azure & OneDrive, Google Drive and Dropbox.
en-US.name: Cyberduck
en-US.releaseNotes:
- [Feature] Support ProxyCommand from ssh_config (SFTP) (#8688)
- [Feature] Sign in with AWS Console browser sign-in (S3) (#18543)
- [Feature] Support authentication with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure) (#17115)
- [Feature] Support virtual folders for spaces (oCIS, OpenCloud) (#14166)
- [Feature] Create buckets with ACLs disabled (S3, Google Storage) (#18526)
- [Feature] Support copy with SSH File Transfer Protocol extension (SFTP) (#14377)
- [Feature] Client-side checksum verification of uploads (S3, Backblaze B2, Dropbox, Google Drive, Google Storage, Box, OpenStack Swift) (#17352)
- [Feature] Retry with exponential backoff when the server rejects the connection (FTP, WebDAV)
- [Feature] Use regional endpoints for public URLs (S3) (#17301)
- [Feature] Preserve modification date of downloaded folders (#10854)
- [Feature] Remove deprecated Shared folder (OneDrive) (#17890)
- [Bugfix] Switch default type for uploads to block blob (Azure) (#18386)
- [Bugfix] Application hangs with large selection of files in browser (#18438)
- [Bugfix] Overwriting files appends to existing file (SFTP) (#18335)
- [Bugfix] Read timeout deleting many files with bulk delete (OpenStack Swift) (#18439)
- [Bugfix] OAuth workflow never finishes with custom redirect URI (CLI; Dropbox, OneDrive, SharePoint) (#13587)
- [Bugfix] Handle timeout during resumable file upload finalization (ownCloud)
- [Bugfix] Error on startup after installing from website (CLI, Windows) (#18408)
- [Bugfix] Support Pageant through OpenSSH agent named pipe configured in ssh_config, replacing the Pageant connector (SFTP, Windows) (#18479)
- [Bugfix] Disable SSH agent with IdentityAgent none in ssh_config (SFTP)
- [Bugfix] Resolve username from server after OAuth authorization (Nextcloud, ownCloud) (#18456)
- [Bugfix] Verify server-side checksum after upload (iRODS) (#18457)
- [Bugfix] Reuse TLS session for data connections with TLS 1.3 (FTP-SSL)
- [Bugfix] Cannot navigate into folders in hierarchical namespace (Azure) (#18455)
- [Bugfix] Network, SSL and token failures surface as "Unknown application error" (Azure) (#18559)
- [Bugfix] Presigned URL signature excludes context path (S3) (#18494)
- [Bugfix] Skip reading ACLs of objects in buckets with object ownership enforced (S3) (#18526)
- [Bugfix] Select private key configured in bookmark in login prompt (#18516)
- [Bugfix] Cannot unset previously saved password in bookmark (#18518)
- [Bugfix] Offer RSA certificates with SHA-2 signature (SFTP) (#18478)
- [Bugfix] Keeps opening re-authorization window after transfer (Google Drive) (#18420)
- [Bugfix] Segment upload fails with 404 in Cryptomator vault (OpenStack Swift) (#18570)
- [Bugfix] Files inside deleted directory are still listed until reloading contents (#17525)
- [Bugfix] Reset cached proxy configuration on network address change (Windows)

zh-CN.description: 一款适用于 Mac 和 Windows 的自由开源服务器及云存储浏览器，支持 FTP、SFTP、WebDAV、Amazon S3、OpenStack Swift、Backblaze B2、Microsoft Azure 和 OneDrive、Google Drive 以及 Dropbox。
